Let's look at the library part description: "Switch:SW_DIP_x02 | 2x DIP Switch, Single Pole Single Throw (SPST) switch, small symbol | pins: 1=(passive) 2=(passive) 3=(passive) 4=(passive)". It doesn't specify internal connections. But we can infer from the netlist of SW7, which is SW_DIP_x04. For SW7, the connections are: GND on 1,2,3,4; signals on 5,6,7,8. If the pairing were 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, then SW7.1 (GND) would connect to SW7.2 (GND) - useless. SW7.3 (GND) to SW7.4 (GND) - useless.
